title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The project successfully supported 460 returnee and host families (2,618 individuals) affected by vulnerabilities through provision of multi-purpose cash assistance (MPCA), enabling them to meet their immediate basic needs during a critical period. Through the provision of unconditional cash assistance, households gained access to food, shelter, clothing, blankets, heating, and other essential non-food items. . Marker 1.5 was selected because the primary objective of the response was to support returnee and host families affected by vulnerabilities through provision of multi-purpose cash assistance, enabling them to meet their immediate basic needs during a critical period. Through the provision of unconditional cash assistance, households gained access to food, shelter, clothing, blankets, heating, and other essential non-food items.
